summary: @NedLamont Hey since we will never use the old Metro-North Bar Cars for intended use, had random idea let's turn them into rolling classrooms. Allow community college students to take a class while commuting back and forth between Bridgeport and New Haven.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @NedLamont Hey since we will never use the old Metro-North Bar Cars for intended use, had random idea let's turn them into rolling classrooms. Allow community college students to take a class while commuting back and forth between Bridgeport and New Haven.
